title: Middle of the Linked List
statement:
Given the head of a singly linked list represented as an array of values, return the values of the list starting from the middle node.

If there are two middle nodes, return the second middle node.

You should implement the Linked List data structure, populate it, and use the **fast and slow pointer** technique to find the middle in a single pass.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers representing the list.
outputFormat: Space-separated integers from the middle node to the end.

examples.explanation: Since the list has two middle nodes (3 and 4), return the second one.
